messages:
anna: :rotating_light: CVE-2026-2154 (libssh auth bypass) reported exploited in the wild. Vendor advisory: https://example.com/advisories/libssh-2026-2154. Affects libssh <= 0.10.7. We package this into edge-ssh-proxy and build-agent images. Immediate triage needed.

Derek: I'm taking incident lead. Fast checklist:
1) inventory usages (containers, images, vendored libs)
2) short-term mitigations (block IPs, disable password auth)
3) PRs to upgrade to 0.10.8 in images and vendor dirs
4) enable detailed SSH audit logs and forward to SIEM
I'll start inventory scan now.

maria: SIEM queries I'm running (Splunk/LogQL):
```
index=security sourcetype=ssh ("authentication failure" OR "Accepted publickey") | stats count by host, user, src_ip
```
Looking for spikes and successful logins from new IPs. Posting findings in ~7m.

anna: quick repo search:
```
rg "libssh" -n || grep -R "libssh" -n third_party/ vendor/ || docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | rg -i libssh
```
Found references in: ingest-gateway (vendored), edge-ssh-proxy (system package inside container image), build-agent (base image). I'll start template PRs.

Derek: notes for CI images: update build script for libssh 0.10.8:
```
# bootstrap/build-libssh.sh
LIBSSH_VERSION=0.10.8
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/libssh.tar.xz https://example.com/libssh-$LIBSSH_VERSION.tar.xz
tar -xJf /tmp/libssh.tar.xz -C /tmp
cmake -S /tmp/libssh-$LIBSSH_VERSION -B /tmp/libssh-build -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr
cmake --build /tmp/libssh-build -j$(nproc) && cmake --install /tmp/libssh-build
```
For apt-based images prefer distro package if patched.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout scheduled for edge-ssh-proxy-canary-1. Artifact: ci/libssh-0.10.8. Healthchecks enabled.

oliver: Ops/CSM note — we should pre-draft internal and customer messaging. Legal and CISO must review. I'll draft internal blurb and a short customer-safe paragraph, will post to #customer-comms for review.

maria: detection update: identified three suspicious source IPs with repeated attempts (a.b.c.12, d.e.f.34, g.h.i.56) targeting edge-ssh-proxy in the last 90 minutes. Found one successful login to a build-agent container where an expired CI token was used. Isolating the host and rotating tokens now. Preserving forensic logs to s3://redwood-security/incidents/INC-2026-2154/.

anna: owners and next steps:
- inventory + PRs: Derek
- detection + host isolation: maria
- canary deploy + rollback plan: Derek + deploy-bot
- comms draft: oliver
- incident doc + PD: jenna
Canary target in 20m, full rollout in 90m if no anomalies.

jenna: opened incident INC-2026-2154 and called PD. War room scheduled in 25 minutes. Legal/Privacy looped.

Derek: immediate mitigations applied at edge layer:
- WAF blocks for suspicious IPs
- tighten SSH config in edge-ssh-proxy:
```
# /etc/edge-ssh-proxy/ssh_config.d/hardening.conf
PasswordAuthentication no
PermitRootLogin no
ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
```
- enforce key-only auth and revoke old service keys. If secrets are in KMS, rotate keys and update secrets manager. Example (aws kms):
```
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id alias/service-account-key --pending-window-in-days 7
# create new CMK and re-encrypt secrets in AWS Secrets Manager
```

maria: build-agent host isolated, disk images and logs collected. No signs of lateral movement yet. I'm correlating container runtime logs and registry access.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to edge-ssh-proxy-canary-1. Health checks OK. Monitoring auth failures and SIEM alerts.

anna: dedicated/private customers note: we'll push emergency patch bundles for Private installers and provide upgrade instructions for Dedicated nodes. Security bulletin will be published internally once rollout validated.

oliver: draft customer message in thread. Short version: we patched affected services and are actively monitoring; we rotated service credentials where needed. Will not publish publicly until legal approves.

Derek: PRs created: github.com/redwood/ingest-gateway/pull/401, github.com/redwood/edge-ssh-proxy/pull/128, github.com/redwood/build-agent/pull/77. Link any other repos that need hotfixes. If you can't get a patch within 2h, ping me and we'll queue a hotfix deploy.

anna: keep posting short status updates here. tagging on-call: @maria @Derek @jenna. :thumbsup:
